figures.alt: Open wooden folding attic stair through a white trimmed ceiling hatch
figures.caption: Pull-down stairs change a ceiling opening into a load-bearing access route. Confirm the opening, framing, landing space, and attic conditions before choosing a stair unit.
figures.before: When You Need a Permit in Jacksonville

figures.alt: Insulated attic hatch with weatherstrip, rigid foam, and raised insulation dam
figures.caption: The new access still belongs in the home's thermal boundary. Plan how the stair or hatch will be insulated and sealed so easier attic access does not become a permanent air leak.

figures.alt: Plywood attic walkway leading safely from an access opening over ceiling framing
figures.caption: Work does not end at the top step. A safe path across the attic protects the ceiling and gives future service work a stable route instead of loose insulation to walk on.
